title: Ajmera Realty & Infra India Ltd (NSE: AJMERA) — Institutional Equity Research Dossier

technical_spec.stage_explanation: Both the 2026-11-23 NSE ledger (₹162.62, +8.93% 1D on 28.44x 20-day average volume; Stage 2 Markup) and the 2026-11-25 live TradingView snapshot (₹160.92; STAGE_2, in_thewrap_stage2: True, RS 82.1) confirm a Stage 2 breakout past Pivot R1 (₹143.85) and Pivot R2 (₹155.11). However, price is severely extended (+18.25% above 10W EMA ₹136.09, +26.90% above 50D SMA ₹126.81, +27.01% above 30W SMA ₹126.70; Daily RSI 76.31, 4H RSI 78.69) following an unexplained volume spike that triggered a Nov 24 Reg 30 clarification (no UPSI). Because contingency-adjusted Base fair value is ₹148.00 (15.6x FY28E EPS ₹9.46) and E[P] is ₹149.00 (-7.4% vs. ₹160.92), new capital is REJECTED (TIER_0; VALUATION, CASH_FLOW) while held shares trim 50% (650 shares) and ratchet the stop to ₹134.00.
technical_spec.evaluation_stage_explanation: Reconciling the 2026-11-23 NSE ledger (₹162.62, Stage 2 Markup, 28.44x vol, RSI 78.26) with the 2026-11-25 live TradingView snapshot (₹160.92, STAGE_2, +18.25% above 10W EMA ₹136.09, +26.90% above 50D SMA ₹126.81, WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT_PULLBACK / CAP_WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT, invalidation stop ₹122.61), we reject new capital (REJECTED / TIER_0) due to negative expected return (-7.4% vs. ₹149.00 E[P]) and 53% CFO/PAT cash drag, trim 650 held shares (50%) into strength, and ratchet the hard stop upward from ₹117.00 to ₹134.00.

holding_rationale: Trim 650 of our 1,300 held Zerodha shares (50%) immediately near ₹160.92 based on forward mark-to-market opportunity cost. At 2026-11-23 ledger close ₹162.62, the stake sits at 4.96% NAV (₹211,406); at 2026-11-25 live TV ₹160.92 (₹209,196), shares trade +8.0% above our ₹148.00 Base fair value (-7.4% E[P] to ₹149.00). Selling 650 shares into the +26.9% 50D-SMA spike harvests ~₹1,04,598 cash and cuts exposure to 650 shares (~2.45% NAV). Ratchet the hard weekly-close stop up from ₹117.00 to ₹134.00 (just below the rising 10W EMA ₹136.09). That tightens forward mark-to-market risk on the remaining 650 shares to -16.7% while preserving Stage 2 trend participation.

holding_alerts.instruction: Trim 650 of 1,300 shares (50%) into the +26.9% 50D-SMA surge (RSI 76.31; Nov 24 Reg 30 confirmed no UPSI), harvesting ~₹1,04,598 cash and reducing weight from 4.96% to ~2.45% NAV.
Exit all remaining 650 shares on any weekly close below ₹134.00 (ratcheted up from ₹117.00; sits just below rising 10W EMA ₹136.09, capping forward mark-to-market downside at -16.7%).

holding_alerts.trigger: Secondary Strength Trim Near Bull Target
holding_alerts.instruction: Trim half of the remaining stake (325 shares) if Stage 2 momentum carries price to ₹195.00 without FY27 pre-sales tracking >= ₹1,800 Cr and debt/adj-CFO staying below 3.0x.

redeployment_plan.capital_source: ~₹1,04,598 gross proceeds from trimming 650 AJMERA shares (50%) plus the next marginal ₹100,000 of IN equity capital (or full proceeds if the ₹134.00 hard stop triggers)

destinations.rationale: Preserve dry powder while Nifty 50 sits in an Uptrend (narrow breadth, 55.2% >50DMA, 3 distribution days) and AJMERA's 86% H2-loaded pre-sales, ₹1,465 Cr planned debt path, and ₹456.89 Cr contingencies remain unresolved.
destinations.entry_condition: Re-evaluate AJMERA only if H2 pre-sales verify >= ₹1,500 Cr, CFO/PAT improves, and price resets well below ₹125.

destinations.recommendation: Allocate 50% to shortlist leader TITAN inside support
destinations.rationale: Active shortlist compounder (2026-11-25 live TV STAGE_2 at ₹4,686.60, +0.15% above 10W EMA ₹4,679.69, RSI 48.77 vs. 2026-11-23 NSE ledger Stage 3 at ₹4,680.00) offering 45.28% ROE and 20.5% ROCE vs. AJMERA's 11.5%–12.41% ROE.
destinations.entry_condition: Stage entries inside TITAN's shortlist support band ₹4,550.00–₹4,696.38 (TV support ₹4,609.49–₹4,749.89) with invalidation stop ₹4,380.00.

destinations.rationale: Superior capital efficiency (14.6%–14.69% ROE, 17.3% ROCE, 0.14x D/E, 57.13% OPM) at ₹1,868.50 live TV (₹1,860.00 ledger), but adding it alongside 650 remaining AJMERA shares would double MMR real-estate beta.
destinations.entry_condition: Revisit only if the remaining 650 AJMERA shares exit on the ₹134.00 stop.

primer: Ajmera Realty (NSE: AJMERA) surged to ₹162.62 on the 2026-11-23 ledger (28.44x volume) and ₹160.92 on 2026-11-25 live TV (18.72x P/E, 2.16x P/B). On November 24, management filed a voluntary Reg 30 note confirming zero undisclosed news behind the volume spike. After applying a ₹22.90/sh haircut for ₹456.89 Cr contingencies alongside ₹1,465 Cr planned debt and 82% receivables coverage, our Base fair value drops to ₹148.00 (15.6x FY28E EPS ₹9.46; E[P] ₹149.00, -7.4%). New capital is REJECTED (TIER_0; VALUATION, CASH_FLOW). On forward mark-to-market risk, we TRIM_INTO_STRENGTH by selling 650 of 1,300 Zerodha shares (50%) and ratcheting our weekly stop up from ₹117.00 to ₹134.00.
